title: HOAide App
tagline: Your AI-powered assistant for HOA communication.
description: HOAide is an AI-powered assistant that streamlines communication between residents and HOA/property managers. By using natural language classification, document parsing, and automated response drafting, HOAide reduces manual workload and improves turnaround time for handling resident concerns. This full-stack SaaS project is built with a subscription-based business model in mind and includes intelligent message triage, document referencing, and administrative controls.
problem: HOA and property managers are overwhelmed by resident emails, often lacking tools to efficiently triage, reference policies, and reply quickly.
solution: HOAide uses AI to auto-classify messages, surface relevant policy documents, and draft responses to reduce response time and improve clarity.
challenges: Tuning classification models for edge cases
Ensuring data privacy for document references
notes: App is a work in progress; backend is stubbed for testing.

title: TreadThread App
tagline: Track your treadmill progress. Connect socially.
description: A treadmill workout tracker that syncs via NFC and displays your progress through a web app with social features.
problem: No modern tools exist to automatically track treadmill workouts with NFC and make them social.
solution: Use NFC and ESP32 to sync treadmill sessions to a web dashboard with progress graphs and social sharing.
notes: Prototype tested with mock treadmill data.

title: Personal Portfolio
tagline: Polished portfolio built for performance and presence.
description: A Nuxt 3 and Tailwind-based personal portfolio site showcasing my experience, projects, and future vision.
problem: Generic portfolio templates didn’t reflect my real skill level or design preferences.
solution: Built a fully customized Nuxt + Tailwind site with structured JSON data and live GitHub integration.
notes: Built mobile-first with a focus on tone, polish, and DevOps-adjacent career framing.

title: XPRT Events Website
tagline: Where photo booth fun meets modern marketing.
description: Marketing website for our photo booth business, built with Nuxt and Laravel. Features booking form, pricing, and reviews.
problem: Needed a polished web presence to legitimize and promote our new business.
solution: Built a Laravel backend with Nuxt frontend for clean SSR experience and easy client updates.
notes: Business still pre-revenue; improving SEO and mobile polish.
